name: RAVine
description: RAVine is a reality-aligned evaluation framework for agentic search systems that assesses multi-point queries and long-form answers reflecting realistic user intents. It introduces an attributable ground truth construction strategy and evaluates the iterative interaction process and efficiency of agentic LLMs with search tools.
reputation: A very recent benchmark with limited public adoption so far, but it targets an important and underexplored setting for agentic search evaluation.
notes: Focuses on fine-grained evaluation of agentic search including iterative process and efficiency; includes code and datasets.
